"""Assemble an empty-prediction workspace using retained native files, without bulk copies.

This login-node preparation checks metadata only. Each inference task must hash
every assigned member against the frozen manifest before and after scoring.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import stat

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
read = lambda p: json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def validate_name(name):
    p = PurePosixPath(name)
    if (not re.fullmatch(r'(matched-kge|benchmark)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+', name)
            or '..' in p.parts or str(p) != name or p.is_absolute()
            or '/scores-' in name or name.endswith('/SCORED.json')):
        raise ValueError('Unsafe or prediction member: ' + name)


def expected_members(manifest, reference):
    assert manifest['schema'] == 1 and reference['status'] == 'passed'
    checkpoint = manifest['provenance']['expected_files']
    assert len(checkpoint) == 701 and sum(n.endswith('.pt') for n in checkpoint) == 400
    assert len(reference['files']) == reference['file_count'] == 142
    assert not set(checkpoint) & set(reference['files'])
    component_files = {}
    for component in manifest['components']:
        assert not set(component_files) & set(component['files'])
        component_files.update({n: {k: r[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}
                                for n, r in component['files'].items()})
    assert component_files == checkpoint
    expected = {**checkpoint, **reference['files']}
    assert len(expected) == 843
    for name, record in expected.items():
        validate_name(name)
        assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', record['sha256'])
        assert type(record['bytes']) is int and record['bytes'] >= 0
    return expected


def source_path(name, plan):
    validate_name(name)
    if name == 'matched-kge/inputs/PROVENANCE.json':
        return Path(plan['annotation_provenance_source'])
    if name == 'matched-kge/inputs/gene_phenotypes.csv':
        return Path(plan['annotation_source'])
    if name.startswith('benchmark/data/'):
        return Path(plan['data_root']) / name.removeprefix('benchmark/data/')
    if name.startswith('matched-kge/') and '/inputs/' not in name:
        return Path(plan['training_root']) / name.removeprefix('matched-kge/')
    raise ValueError('Unmapped member: ' + name)


def source_metadata(path, expected_bytes):
    path = Path(path)
    if path.is_symlink() or any(p.is_symlink() for p in path.parents):
        raise ValueError('Symlink in retained source: ' + str(path))
    info = path.stat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_size != expected_bytes:
        raise ValueError('Missing, nonregular or wrong-size retained source: ' + str(path))
    return dict(device=info.st_dev, inode=info.st_ino, bytes=info.st_size,
                mtime_ns=info.st_mtime_ns)


def assemble(workspace, expected, plan):
    workspace = Path(workspace)
    assert not workspace.exists() and not workspace.is_symlink()
    records = {}
    # Complete preflight before creating the destination or any hard links.
    for name, record in expected.items():
        source = source_path(name, plan)
        metadata = source_metadata(source, record['bytes'])
        assert metadata['device'] == workspace.parent.stat().st_dev, 'Refuse a bulk copy across filesystems'
        records[name] = dict(source=str(source), **metadata)
    workspace.mkdir()
    for name, record in expected.items():
        source = Path(records[name]['source'])
        identity = {k: records[name][k] for k in ('device', 'inode', 'bytes')}
        assert {k: v for k, v in source_metadata(source, record['bytes']).items() if k in identity} == identity
        target = workspace / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        os.link(source, target, follow_symlinks=False)
        # ORIX updates mtime when a hard link is created; it is not a content check.
        assert {k: v for k, v in source_metadata(target, record['bytes']).items() if k in identity} == identity
        assert source.samefile(target)
    actual = {p.relative_to(workspace).as_posix() for p in workspace.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    assert actual == set(expected)
    return records


def main():
    plan = read(ROOT/'staging-plan.json')
    assert plan['stage_script_sha256'] == sha(__file__)
    assert plan['source_proof_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'SOURCE_READY.json')
    source = read(ROOT/'SOURCE_READY.json')
    assert source['status'] == 'passed'
    assert source['commits'] == {'source': '68101ed08e3e271f5f2276724f8a5338b9cf32a2',
                                  'training-source': '063efc263446b4d119d3dbf4b97edb8709859f1e'}
    assert plan['manifest_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'checkpoint-release-manifest.json')
    assert plan['input_reference_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'INPUTS_REFERENCE.json')
    assert not (ROOT/'STAGED_INPUTS.json').exists()
    manifest = read(ROOT/'checkpoint-release-manifest.json')
    reference = read(ROOT/'INPUTS_REFERENCE.json')
    assert manifest['provenance']['freeze_sha256'] == plan['freeze_sha256']
    assert reference['source_proof_sha256'] == plan['source_proof_sha256']
    expected = expected_members(manifest, reference)
    assert sha(Path(plan['training_root'])/'FROZEN.json') == plan['freeze_sha256']
    assert sha(Path(plan['annotation_provenance_source'])) == expected['matched-kge/inputs/PROVENANCE.json']['sha256']
    records = assemble(ROOT/'workspace', expected, plan)
    result = dict(status='passed', transport='native_hardlinks',
        verification='metadata_only_before_task_hashes', source_proof_sha256=plan['source_proof_sha256'],
        stage_script_sha256=sha(__file__), staging_plan_sha256=sha(ROOT/'staging-plan.json'),
        manifest_sha256=plan['manifest_sha256'], input_reference_sha256=plan['input_reference_sha256'],
        freeze_sha256=plan['freeze_sha256'], checkpoint_files=400, checkpoint_collection_files=701,
        file_count=843, files=expected, retained_sources=records, no_predictions_before_inference=True,
        scope='Fresh prediction-free workspace linked from retained native inputs and selected weights. This is metadata-only preparation, not a new public download or member-hash verification. Every one of the 843 frozen member hashes must be checked by the inference tasks before and after scoring, followed by independent CPU verification.')
    with (ROOT/'STAGED_INPUTS.json').open('x') as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(status='passed',files=843,weights=400,transport=result['transport'],
                          staging_proof_sha256=sha(ROOT/'STAGED_INPUTS.json'))),flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Independently score one full matched fold from verified retained checkpoints."""
import argparse
import fcntl
from importlib.metadata import version
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = ROOT.parent
TRAINING = ROOT/'training-source'
SOURCE = ROOT/'source'
sys.path.insert(0, str(TRAINING/'code'))
from phenoquery.common import read, sha, write
from training.run_matched_kge import MODELS, GRAPHS, PRIMARY, validate_completion

CHOICES = {'raw_mr', 'raw_head', 'calibrated_mr', 'calibrated_head'}


def runs_for_fold(fold):
    assert type(fold) is int and 0 <= fold < 10
    return [f'fold{fold}/{graph}/{model}' for graph in GRAPHS for model in MODELS]


def score_command(identity, root, data, annotations, source=TRAINING):
    settings = identity['settings']
    model = settings['model']
    assert model in MODELS and identity['graph'] in GRAPHS
    assert type(identity['fold']) is int and 0 <= identity['fold'] < 10
    assert settings['device'] == 'cuda' and settings['seed'] == 0
    assert settings['dimension'] == (400 if model == 'INDIGENA' else 200)
    assert settings['early_stopping'] is False and settings['primary'] == PRIMARY[model]
    fixed = dict(epochs=1000, profile_epochs=20, validation_frequency=20,
        checkpoint_frequency=20, batch_size=65536, sub_batch_size=8192, expected_candidates=13625)
    assert all(settings[name] == value for name,value in fixed.items())
    command = [sys.executable, '-u', str(source/'code/training/run_matched_kge.py'),
        '--phase', 'score', '--root', str(root), '--data-root', str(data),
        '--fold', str(identity['fold']), '--graph', identity['graph'], '--model', model,
        '--device', 'cuda', '--gene-phenotypes', str(annotations)]
    for name in ('seed', 'dimension', *fixed):
        command += ['--'+name.replace('_','-'), str(settings[name])]
    return command


def clean_start(root, fold):
    for relative in runs_for_fold(fold):
        folder = root/relative
        assert not (folder/'SCORED.json').exists(), relative
        assert not list(folder.glob('scores-*')), relative


def completed_run(root, relative, frozen_digest):
    folder = root/relative
    trained = validate_completion(folder)
    scored = read(folder/'SCORED.json')
    assert scored['freeze_sha256'] == frozen_digest
    assert scored['training_sha256'] == sha(folder/'TRAINED.json')
    assert scored['primary'] == trained['primary']
    assert set(scored['files']) == {'scores-'+choice+'.npz' for choice in CHOICES}
    for name,digest in scored['files'].items():
        path = folder/name
        assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and sha(path) == digest, str(path)
    return dict(run=relative, scored_sha256=sha(folder/'SCORED.json'), files=scored['files'])


def members_for_fold(files, fold):
    assert type(fold) is int and fold in range(10)
    assert len(files) == 843
    for name, record in files.items():
        path = PurePosixPath(name)
        assert re.fullmatch(r'(matched-kge|benchmark)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+', name)
        assert '..' not in path.parts and str(path) == name
        assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', record['sha256'])
        assert type(record['bytes']) is int and record['bytes'] >= 0
        assert '/scores-' not in name and not name.endswith('/SCORED.json')
    shared = {'matched-kge/FROZEN.json', 'matched-kge/inputs/PROVENANCE.json',
              'matched-kge/inputs/gene_phenotypes.csv'}
    assert shared <= files.keys()
    selected = {name: record for name, record in files.items()
                if name.startswith(f'matched-kge/fold{fold}/')
                or name.startswith(f'benchmark/data/fold{fold}/') or name in shared}
    assert len(selected) == 87
    assert sum(n.startswith(f'matched-kge/fold{fold}/') and n.endswith('.pt') for n in selected) == 40
    assert sum(n.endswith('/TRAINED.json') for n in selected) == 10
    assert sum(n.startswith(f'benchmark/data/fold{fold}/') for n in selected) == 14
    return selected


def validate_sample(sample, source_digest):
    assert sample['status'] == 'passed' and sample['all_validation_metrics_exact']
    assert sample['checkpoint_files'] == 12 and sample['job_id'] == 355504
    assert sample['cpu_threads'] == sample['allocated_cpus'] == 8
    assert sample['source_proof_sha256'] == source_digest
    runs = ('fold0/original/U1', 'fold0/nobridge/U1', 'fold0/original/T1')
    assert len(sample['records']) == 12
    assert {(r['run'], r['choice']) for r in sample['records']} == {(r,c) for r in runs for c in CHOICES}
    assert all(r['metrics_exact'] and r['actual'] == r['expected'] for r in sample['records'])


def validate_runtime(runtime, sample):
    assert runtime['torch'] == sample['runtime']['torch'] == '2.10.0+cu128'
    assert runtime['numpy'] == sample['runtime']['numpy'] == '2.4.2'
    assert runtime['pykeen'] == sample['runtime']['pykeen'] == '1.11.1'
    assert runtime['capability'] == sample['runtime']['capability'] == [9, 0]
    assert 'H200' in runtime['gpu']
    assert runtime['threads'] == runtime['cpus'] == 8
    assert runtime['matmul_tf32'] == sample['runtime']['tf32_matmul']
    assert runtime['cudnn_tf32'] == sample['runtime']['tf32_cudnn']


def validate_staging(staged, plan, root):
    assert staged['status'] == 'passed' and staged['transport'] == 'native_hardlinks'
    assert staged['verification'] == 'metadata_only_before_task_hashes'
    assert staged['staging_plan_sha256'] == sha(root/'staging-plan.json')
    assert staged['stage_script_sha256'] == sha(root/'stage-inputs.py')
    assert staged['manifest_sha256'] == sha(root/'checkpoint-release-manifest.json')
    assert staged['input_reference_sha256'] == sha(root/'INPUTS_REFERENCE.json')
    assert staged['checkpoint_files'] == 400 and staged['checkpoint_collection_files'] == 701
    assert staged['file_count'] == len(staged['files']) == 843
    assert staged['no_predictions_before_inference'] is True
    assert staged['source_proof_sha256'] == plan['source_proof_sha256']
    manifest, reference = read(root/'checkpoint-release-manifest.json'), read(root/'INPUTS_REFERENCE.json')
    assert not set(manifest['provenance']['expected_files']) & set(reference['files'])
    assert staged['files'] == {**manifest['provenance']['expected_files'], **reference['files']}
    assert staged['freeze_sha256'] == manifest['provenance']['freeze_sha256']
    assert reference['source_proof_sha256'] == plan['source_proof_sha256']
    for fold in range(10):
        members_for_fold(staged['files'], fold)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--task', type=int, choices=range(10), required=True)
    fold = parser.parse_args().task
    assert int(os.environ['SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID']) == fold % 3
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    plan = read(ROOT/'inference-plan.json')
    assert plan['operation_script_sha256'] == sha(Path(__file__))
    assert plan['sbatch_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'run-inference.sbatch')
    source, staged = read(ROOT/'SOURCE_READY.json'), read(ROOT/'STAGED_INPUTS.json')
    assert source['status'] == staged['status'] == 'passed'
    assert plan['source_proof_sha256'] == staged['source_proof_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'SOURCE_READY.json')
    assert plan['staging_proof_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'STAGED_INPUTS.json')
    assert staged['staging_plan_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'staging-plan.json')
    assert staged['checkpoint_files'] == 400 and staged['checkpoint_collection_files'] == 701
    assert staged['no_predictions_before_inference'] is True
    assert source['commits'] == dict(source='68101ed08e3e271f5f2276724f8a5338b9cf32a2',
        **{'training-source':'063efc263446b4d119d3dbf4b97edb8709859f1e'})
    for folder in ('source', 'training-source'):
        assert subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(ROOT/folder),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip() == source['commits'][folder]
        assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(ROOT/folder),'status','--porcelain'],text=True)
    for folder,key in [('source','analysis_files'), ('training-source','training_files')]:
        for name,digest in source[key].items():
            assert sha(ROOT/folder/name) == digest, name
    sample = ROOT/'validation-verification.json'
    assert sha(sample) == plan['validation_sample_proof_sha256'] == 'b83fb30e8e378babc448dd609803b40c446a006344c685ef56d665fa68fc2e95'
    sample_proof = read(sample)
    validate_sample(sample_proof, plan['source_proof_sha256'])
    assert sha(ROOT/'validation-native-completion.log') == plan['validation_native_sha256'] == '4389a78e02ad371b2048c3d5fb259f81a5f212b9a973b4f94c52656d1de7f48b'
    assert (ROOT/'validation-native-completion.log').read_text().strip() == '355504|COMPLETED|0:0|00:01:52'
    validate_staging(staged, plan, ROOT)
    assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    assert all(os.environ[name] == '8' for name in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS'))
    torch.set_num_threads(8)
    validate_runtime(dict(torch=str(torch.__version__), numpy=np.__version__, pykeen=version('pykeen'),
        gpu=torch.cuda.get_device_name(), capability=list(torch.cuda.get_device_capability()),
        matmul_tf32=torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32, cudnn_tf32=torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32,
        threads=torch.get_num_threads(), cpus=int(os.environ['SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK'])), sample_proof)
    runs = ROOT/'workspace/matched-kge'
    data = ROOT/'workspace/benchmark/data'
    annotations = runs/'inputs/gene_phenotypes.csv'
    frozen_digest = sha(runs/'FROZEN.json')
    assert frozen_digest == plan['freeze_sha256'] == staged['freeze_sha256']
    assert sha(annotations) == '94829ab611a3f02c4c33d3686028d8eded187c256f852d4e2cecb2f548b4d0b6'
    frozen = read(runs/'FROZEN.json')
    assert set(frozen['training']) == {r for f in range(10) for r in runs_for_fold(f)}
    expected = staged['files']
    own_files = members_for_fold(expected, fold)
    for name,record in own_files.items():
        path = ROOT/'workspace'/name
        assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink()
        assert path.stat().st_size == record['bytes'] and sha(path) == record['sha256'], name
    output = ROOT/'gpu-runs'/f'fold{fold}'
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lock = (output/'allocation.lock').open('w')
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    identity = dict(fold=fold, inference_plan_sha256=sha(ROOT/'inference-plan.json'),
        staging_proof_sha256=sha(ROOT/'STAGED_INPUTS.json'), freeze_sha256=frozen_digest,
        operation_script_sha256=sha(__file__), training_source_commit=source['commits']['training-source'],
        no_test_predictions=True, member_hashes={n:r['sha256'] for n,r in own_files.items()})
    if (output/'STARTED.json').exists():
        assert read(output/'STARTED.json') == identity
    else:
        clean_start(runs, fold)
        write(output/'STARTED.json', identity)
    job, attempt = int(os.environ['SLURM_JOB_ID']), int(os.environ.get('SLURM_RESTART_COUNT','0'))
    fingerprint = output/f'attempt-{job}-{attempt}.json'
    assert not fingerprint.exists()
    runtime = dict(job_id=job, array_job_id=int(os.environ['SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID']),
        restart_count=attempt, fold=fold, array_task_id=int(os.environ['SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID']), started_unix=time.time(),
        allocated_cpus=int(os.environ['SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK']), cpu_affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
        torch=str(torch.__version__), numpy=np.__version__, pykeen=version('pykeen'),
        gpu=torch.cuda.get_device_name(), capability=list(torch.cuda.get_device_capability()),
        matmul_tf32=torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32, cudnn_tf32=torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32,
        cpu_threads=torch.get_num_threads(), started_proof_sha256=sha(output/'STARTED.json'))
    write(fingerprint, runtime)
    records = []
    for relative in runs_for_fold(fold):
        folder = runs/relative
        assert frozen['training'][relative] == sha(folder/'TRAINED.json')
        run_identity = read(folder/'identity.json')
        assert f"fold{run_identity['fold']}/{run_identity['graph']}/{run_identity['settings']['model']}" == relative
        command = score_command(run_identity, runs, data, annotations)
        subprocess.run(command, check=True)
        records.append(completed_run(runs, relative, frozen_digest))
        write(output/'progress.json', dict(completed_runs=len(records), expected_runs=10, records=records))
        print('INFERENCE_RUN_COMPLETE', relative, flush=True)
    assert sha(runs/'FROZEN.json') == frozen_digest
    for name,record in own_files.items():
        assert sha(ROOT/'workspace'/name) == record['sha256'], name
    for folder,key in [('source', 'analysis_files'), ('training-source', 'training_files')]:
        for name,digest in source[key].items(): assert sha(ROOT/folder/name) == digest, name
    assert len(records) == 10 and sum(len(r['files']) for r in records) == 40
    if (output/'COMPLETE.json').exists():
        previous = read(output/'COMPLETE.json')
        assert previous['status'] == 'inference_completed' and previous['records'] == records
        assert previous['started_proof_sha256'] == sha(output/'STARTED.json')
        assert Path(previous['environment_file']).name == previous['environment_file']
        assert previous['environment_sha256'] == sha(output/previous['environment_file'])
    else:
        write(output/'COMPLETE.json', dict(status='inference_completed', fold=fold,
            training_runs=10, score_files=40, records=records, started_proof_sha256=sha(output/'STARTED.json'),
            environment_file=fingerprint.name, environment_sha256=sha(fingerprint),
            elapsed_seconds=time.time()-runtime['started_unix'],
            scope='Independent original-scorer execution from retained checkpoints matching the frozen release identities; numerical and full bias-condition comparisons remain required.'))
    print('INFERENCE_FOLD_COMPLETE', fold, flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Capture completed matched H200 inference without reading large arrays on login."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FAMILIES = ('U1', 'T1', 'INDIGENA', 'CONVKB', 'PPOOL')
CHOICES = ('raw_mr', 'raw_head', 'calibrated_mr', 'calibrated_head')
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
read = lambda p: json.loads(Path(p).read_text())


def native_tasks(text, array):
    if type(array) is not int or array <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid native array')
    result = {}
    for line in text.strip().splitlines():
        name, raw, state, code = line.strip().split('|')
        if not re.fullmatch(str(array)+r'_[0-2]', name):
            raise ValueError('Unexpected native task')
        task = int(name.split('_')[1])
        if task in result or not raw.isdigit() or int(raw) <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Duplicate or invalid native task')
        if state != 'COMPLETED' or code != '0:0':
            raise ValueError('Every task must complete successfully')
        result[task] = int(raw)
    if set(result) != set(range(3)) or len(set(result.values())) != 3:
        raise ValueError('Require three distinct completed allocations for all ten folds')
    return {fold: result[fold % 3] for fold in range(10)}


def run_names(fold):
    return {f'fold{fold}/{g}/{m}' for g in ('original', 'nobridge') for m in FAMILIES}


def score_names():
    return {'scores-'+choice+'.npz' for choice in CHOICES}


def validate_records(complete, fold):
    if (complete['status'] != 'inference_completed' or complete['fold'] != fold
            or complete['training_runs'] != 10 or complete['score_files'] != 40):
        raise ValueError('Incomplete fold')
    records = complete['records']
    if len(records) != 10 or {r['run'] for r in records} != run_names(fold):
        raise ValueError('Incorrect or duplicated run inventory')
    for record in records:
        if set(record['files']) != score_names():
            raise ValueError('Missing or extra score selection')
        for digest in [record['scored_sha256'], *record['files'].values()]:
            if not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', digest):
                raise ValueError('Invalid scorer digest')
    return records


def workspace_inventory(root, public_files):
    expected = set(public_files)
    if len(expected) != 843:
        raise ValueError('Incomplete public input inventory')
    for fold in range(10):
        for run in run_names(fold):
            expected |= {'matched-kge/'+run+'/'+name for name in score_names() | {'SCORED.json', 'run.lock'}}
    paths = list(root.rglob('*'))
    if any(p.is_symlink() for p in paths):
        raise ValueError('Symlink in inference workspace')
    if {p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in paths if p.is_file()} != expected:
        raise ValueError('Inference workspace inventory differs')
    for fold in range(10):
        for run in run_names(fold):
            if (root/'matched-kge'/run/'run.lock').read_bytes() != b'':
                raise ValueError('Nonempty scorer lock')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--array', type=int, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert not (ROOT/'NATIVE_CAPTURE.json').exists()
    plan = read(ROOT/'inference-plan.json')
    assert plan['capture_script_sha256'] == sha(__file__)
    command = ['sacct', '--array', '-X', '-n', '-P', '-j', str(args.array),
               '--format=JobID%40,JobIDRaw%40,State,ExitCode']
    native = subprocess.check_output(command, text=True)
    jobs = native_tasks(native, args.array)
    metadata, binaries, scores = {}, {}, {}

    def capture(name):
        path = ROOT/name
        assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), name
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        metadata[name] = dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), bytes=len(raw), text=raw.decode())
        return json.loads(raw) if path.suffix == '.json' else None

    for name in ('inference-plan.json', 'SOURCE_READY.json', 'INPUTS_REFERENCE.json',
                 'STAGED_INPUTS.json', 'staging-plan.json', 'checkpoint-release-manifest.json',
                 'stage-inputs.py', 'annotation-provenance.json',
                 'validation-verification.json', 'validation-native-completion.log',
                 'run-inference.py', 'run-inference.sbatch', 'capture-native.py'):
        capture(name)
    for key, name in [('operation_script_sha256', 'run-inference.py'),
                      ('sbatch_sha256', 'run-inference.sbatch'),
                      ('source_proof_sha256', 'SOURCE_READY.json'),
                      ('staging_proof_sha256', 'STAGED_INPUTS.json'),
                      ('validation_sample_proof_sha256', 'validation-verification.json'),
                      ('validation_native_sha256', 'validation-native-completion.log')]:
        assert plan[key] == metadata[name]['sha256'], name
    staged = read(ROOT/'STAGED_INPUTS.json')
    assert staged['status'] == 'passed' and staged['no_predictions_before_inference']
    assert staged['checkpoint_files'] == 400 and staged['checkpoint_collection_files'] == 701
    assert staged['staging_plan_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'staging-plan.json')
    assert staged['source_proof_sha256'] == plan['source_proof_sha256']
    sample = read(ROOT/'validation-verification.json')
    workspace_inventory(ROOT/'workspace', staged['files'])
    for fold in range(10):
        prefix = f'gpu-runs/fold{fold}'
        complete = capture(prefix+'/COMPLETE.json')
        start = capture(prefix+'/STARTED.json')
        assert start['fold'] == fold and start['no_test_predictions']
        assert start['inference_plan_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'inference-plan.json')
        assert start['staging_proof_sha256'] == plan['staging_proof_sha256']
        assert start['operation_script_sha256'] == plan['operation_script_sha256']
        assert start['freeze_sha256'] == plan['freeze_sha256'] == staged['freeze_sha256']
        own = {n:r['sha256'] for n,r in staged['files'].items()
               if n.startswith(f'matched-kge/fold{fold}/')
               or n.startswith(f'benchmark/data/fold{fold}/')
               or n in ('matched-kge/FROZEN.json', 'matched-kge/inputs/PROVENANCE.json',
                        'matched-kge/inputs/gene_phenotypes.csv')}
        assert len(own) == 87 and start['member_hashes'] == own
        assert start['training_source_commit'] == '063efc263446b4d119d3dbf4b97edb8709859f1e'
        assert complete['started_proof_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/prefix/'STARTED.json')
        name = complete['environment_file']
        assert re.fullmatch(r'attempt-[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.json', name)
        runtime = capture(prefix+'/'+name)
        assert metadata[prefix+'/'+name]['sha256'] == complete['environment_sha256']
        wanted = dict(job_id=jobs[fold], array_job_id=args.array, fold=fold,
                      allocated_cpus=8, cpu_threads=8, array_task_id=fold % 3, capability=[9, 0],
                      torch='2.10.0+cu128', numpy='2.4.2', pykeen='1.11.1',
                      started_proof_sha256=sha(ROOT/prefix/'STARTED.json'))
        assert all(runtime[k] == v for k, v in wanted.items())
        assert 'H200' in runtime['gpu']
        assert runtime['matmul_tf32'] == sample['runtime']['tf32_matmul']
        assert runtime['cudnn_tf32'] == sample['runtime']['tf32_cudnn']
        for path in (ROOT/prefix).glob('attempt-*.json'):
            attempt = capture(path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
            assert attempt['job_id'] == jobs[fold] and attempt['array_job_id'] == args.array
        for record in validate_records(complete, fold):
            relative = 'workspace/matched-kge/'+record['run']
            scored = capture(relative+'/SCORED.json')
            assert metadata[relative+'/SCORED.json']['sha256'] == record['scored_sha256']
            assert scored['files'] == record['files']
            assert scored['freeze_sha256'] == plan['freeze_sha256']
            assert scored['training_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/relative/'TRAINED.json')
            assert capture(relative+'/run.lock') is None
            scores[relative+'/SCORED.json'] = record['scored_sha256']
            for name, digest in record['files'].items():
                path = ROOT/relative/name
                assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_size > 0
                binaries[relative+'/'+name] = dict(sha256=digest, bytes=path.stat().st_size)
                scores[relative+'/'+name] = digest
    assert len(binaries) == 400 and len(scores) == 500
    for name, record in metadata.items():
        assert sha(ROOT/name) == record['sha256'], name
    assert native_tasks(subprocess.check_output(command, text=True), args.array) == jobs
    (ROOT/'native-completion.log').write_text(native)
    result = dict(status='native_completed', cluster='orix', inference_array=args.array,
        inference_plan_sha256=sha(ROOT/'inference-plan.json'), capture_script_sha256=sha(__file__),
        native_completion_sha256=sha(ROOT/'native-completion.log'),
        native_fold_job_ids={str(k):v for k,v in jobs.items()}, native_allocations=3, folds=10, captured_unix=time.time(),
        score_files_sha256=scores, metadata_files=metadata, binary_files=binaries,
        scope='Three completed native allocations cover all ten completed folds and all 400 declared score hashes. Large binary hashes and scientific equivalence require destination CPU verification.')
    temporary = ROOT/'NATIVE_CAPTURE.pending'
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
    temporary.replace(ROOT/'NATIVE_CAPTURE.json')
    print(json.dumps(dict(status=result['status'], array=args.array, metadata_files=len(metadata),
        binary_files=len(binaries), binary_bytes=sum(r['bytes'] for r in binaries.values()),
        capture_sha256=sha(ROOT/'NATIVE_CAPTURE.json'))), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

scope: Three completed native allocations cover all ten completed folds and all 400 declared score hashes. Large binary hashes and scientific equivalence require destination CPU verification.
